note: Backend eval-run endpoint now raises DRF errors (NotFound, raise_exception); frontend drops the custom error-message parsing and relies on the global handler.
Adds env-configured connections, flush concurrency and max series per bucket via envconfig with validation, threaded through a CounterConfig struct.
Commit creates the empty-state file with a per-card consent state in each ConsentGatedTemplateCard; no shared state at the TemplatesEmptyState level.
Adds a heatmap:read scope for heatmap_url export contexts; no shared helper for scope widening with APIScopePermission.
Replaces the os.getenv-parsed SES_ISP_DIMENSIONS with a constant list and updates the comment.
Request path now queues training deletion only for distinct IDs with no resolved person, removing the duplicate queueing; unmatched IDs still queued on request.
Removes value_heap_bytes from properties.rs and uses estimate_json_heap_size from utils/json_size.rs instead.
Deletes the custom esbuild, dev, deps-allowlist and import-boundary scripts, replacing them with an oxlint import rule and a small build script.
Copies scheduled-change context onto the locked instance in the serializer update; does not extract a shared body for the two rollout actions.
Adds AI byte budget charging to the v1 pipeline via charge_ai_bytes; only a doc-comment change in setup.rs, threshold not derived from producer config.
Drops the OP_RETURN literal and pushes Value::from(Operation::Return), moving the explanatory comment inline.
Renames replaying/is_replaying to redelivering/is_redelivering and updates comments; adds a twice-failing resend test.
Removes the local tokenCountOf and uses a shared aiTokenCount helper in utils, also used by MetadataHeader.
Moves tag loading from dashboard/insight wrapper components into SceneTagsCombobox itself, loading tags from tagsModel on open.
Adds a 5s idle-socket timeout for object storage and edits a comment in query_cache storage; no use of is_s3_pointer.
Rewrites the serialization module doc comment about data_type resolution; logging in the encoding layer is untouched.
Pairs each group message with its offset in a GroupMessage struct and renames the index map; keyless messages still get individual groups.
Removes ExperimentRuleIdentity and gives RuleV2 a plain experiment_id int or None; adds rule/return type validation.
Keeps the telemetry activity but makes it sync and uses ph_scoped_capture; adds a comment justifying the activity.
Threads capture_ph_event through create/update, token resolution and rejection capture, adds dedup and refresh-path tests.
